seo.title: Women's Strength Studio in Cairns | FIT X Studio, Manunda
seo.description: Coached strength classes for women in Manunda, Cairns, capped at 14. Mat Pilates, mums and bubs, Saturday HIIT and open gym. Try 2 weeks unlimited for $89.

hero.headline: Walk in knowing exactly what to do.
hero.sub: Coached strength for women, in classes of no more than 14. Your coach watches your form, every session is part of a five-week training block, and the room is full of women backing each other.
hero.note: 2 weeks unlimited · then Premium $75/week · no joining fee

vsl.headline: Meet Coach Loz and the studio

items.title: You walk up to the squat rack like it's yours.
items.body: A coach has shown you how to set it up, how deep to go and what to load. So you just get on with it.

items.title: You stop wondering if you're doing it right.
items.body: With 14 women and a coach in the room, someone sees your form every set and tells you what to change.

items.title: You can see yourself getting stronger.
items.body: Each five-week block repeats the main lifts, so you practise your technique, add weight and track your progress.

items.title: Having a baby doesn't put training on hold.
items.body: Bring bub to mums and bubs. There's a play pen within view, so you can train and keep an eye on them.

story.headline: From Coach Loz

items.title: Grab your 2-week trial
items.body: $89 on Mindbody for two weeks of unlimited classes. Fill in your pre-exercise screening before your first session.

items.title: Learn the lifts
items.body: Book a beginner workshop and your first classes. Your coach shows you the main lifts and helps you pick your starting weights.

items.title: Stay on as Premium
items.body: Love it? Keep going on Premium at $75 a week. Your two trial weeks count towards your minimum term.

offer.headline: Everything in the studio, one membership.
offer.sub: Premium is the membership we built the studio around. It's the only one with the workshops, the app and online coaching.
terms: Your 2 trial weeks count towards your minimum term
Your fee won't go up during your minimum term
3 business days to cool off after signing
offer.footnote: Strength and Pilates classes are capped at 14. Bookings open two weeks ahead.

classes.headline: The classes

items.title: Coached strength
items.body: Our main class. Structured weight training in a small group, programmed in five-week blocks. Max 14.

items.title: Mat Pilates
items.body: Core, sculpt and control on the mat (no reformers), to go with your lifting. Max 14. Grip socks required.

items.title: Mums and bubs
items.body: The same structure as our strength classes, with your little one in the play pen within view.

items.title: Saturday HIIT
items.body: Bring a training partner of any gender and work in doubles, Hyrox-style.

classes.more: Also on Premium: staffed open gym sessions (max 10) and our beginner workshops.

others.eyebrow: Other ways to train with us
others.headline: Want just one thing?
others.sub: Premium is the one we recommend. If you only want one type of class, these memberships are standard rate with the same terms.
others.packsNote: Prices include GST and may change. The fee schedule you're given when you join applies.

final.headline: Your first two weeks start here.
final.sub: Two weeks of unlimited classes for $89. Then Premium at $75 a week if you'd like to stay.
final.crossOnline: Not in Cairns, or can't make class times?
